PSED · M3 · Phase 4

Twin validation against measured KB profiles

The KB-parameterised Ylilammi twin (ylilammi_langmuir_channel) is run against every measured conformality profile across all four papers and scored with the same curve engine used across the KB. Missing twin inputs are covariate-imputed from the KB — and because an imputed value is only an estimate, it is a candidate cause of any mismatch, tracked separately below.
40thermal profiles (in scope)
3agree
11model gap (all inputs measured)
0estimation gap (an input imputed)
26data gap (an input assumed)
0out of scope (plasma)
Verdict is set by the provenance of the two penetration-setting inputs (dose & gap height): model gap = both measured, twin still misses → real Ylilammi-physics / literature-K,c limit · estimation gap = an input is a KB estimate, which may itself be the cause, not the model · data gap = an input was assumed → measure it · out of scope = plasma / recombination-limited (Arts), which the thermal twin doesn't model — see future work.

Twin vs measured — worst & best fits

Penetration depth: twin vs measured

On the diagonal = the twin reproduces the measured penetration. Off-diagonal reds are where literature parameters + the Ylilammi physics miss the real profile.

Inverse fit — recovering the assumed conditions

The forward twin above runs on KB-imputed inputs. Here we instead hold the EXTRACTED conditions fixed, warm-start the imputed ones, and optimise the two identifiable free parameters — exposure (pA·t_p, sets penetration depth) and the lumped sticking coefficient c (sets front sharpness) — to fit each profile on its own coordinate. This is the same inverse procedure the source papers use to extract c. Click a row to watch the fit converge (warm→fit) and read the recovered values.
